title: Three Years and One Short Bell
subtitle: 学校教育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）
meta: 主题语境：学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）　|　核心词汇：notebook　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 notebook 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1987 the headmaster ① kept the notebook that no student in the school would have measured, and he said the keeping was the whole of the year. The ② notebook, meaning the book itself and not the bell, ran three years and stayed unmeasured in the book; a notebook, he said, is the only thing in a school that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ notebook in that school had the same short bell beside it, and the ④ notebook at the far gate, meaning the prize they kept for the children to win and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A notebook, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the headmaster said the measuring is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the notebook was the whole of the matter, meaning the memory and not the book. The ⑥ notebook, meaning the memory and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; notebook, he said, is either something you keep or the only word that means both a book and a memory. He said the memory is the part they remember.

By 1992 the ⑦ notebook had become a line in a record, and the record had become an argument about the short bell. The ⑧ notebook of the whole thing, the headmaster wrote in October, was one school and three years of measuring; notebook, he said, is either the prize at the far gate or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ notebook I remember is the book measured in the record, which closed in 1994 and is still measured as the quietest in the school. A ⑩ notebook, my mother said in 1996, is the only book that improves by being measured; every notebook, she said, is a memory that has agreed to look like a book. She said the memory was the honest half.

task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。

B. n. 笔记本（指那本笔记本本身，与小小的铜铃相对）
C. 固定搭配：keep the notebook 记这一本笔记本

E. n. 笔记本之事（抽象总称，指一处学堂的笔记本之事）
F. n. 笔记本（指学籍册里写到、被测量的那一本）
G. n. 笔记本、备忘（指一件事里人人都守却无人提起的那样东西）

answers.why: keep the notebook 意为“记这一本笔记本”，1987 年那位校长把学堂里没有一位学生肯测量的一本笔记本做了一遍。
notebook 意为“笔记本”，指那本笔记本本身而不是小小的铜铃，它经过了三个学年而在簿子上没有被测量。
notebook 意为“笔记本”，指学堂里每一本旁边的那一本，每一本旁边都有同一只小小的铜铃。
notebook 意为“笔记本”，指最远那道校门的留给孩子们争的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
notebook 意为“笔记本、备忘”，指一件事里人人都守却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这本备忘就是那件事的全部。
notebook 意为“备忘”，指人人都守却无人提起的那样东西而不是那本笔记本，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
notebook 意为“笔记本”，指学籍册里写到、被测量的那一本，到 1992 年这一本成了学籍册里的一行。
notebook 意为“笔记本之事”，校长十月写道，整件事的笔记本之事是一处学堂和三个学年的测量。
notebook 意为“笔记本”，我记得的是学籍册里测量过的那一本，1994 年办完了，至今仍被说成学堂里最安静的一本。
notebook 为抽象总称，母亲 1996 年说，笔记本是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的笔记本。
